message: Added 0.5 to Z in 3 words on 3 blocks, 1 of them a cycle position. Left 7 blocks and 3 words as written: 1 machine position, 2 cycles not reviewed, 2 cycle calls with positions of their own, 2 cycles with a variable position, 2 data words, 1 incremental word. No machine chosen: words whose reading depends on the machine are left alone.

findings.message: Z-20: a value of BLK FORM, not a position of this program.
Z+0: a value of BLK FORM, not a position of this program.
9 CYCL DEF 200 DRILLING ~: part of the same cycle as line 29, which is left as written (positions of its own).
10 CYCL CALL POS X+40 Y+40 Z+0 FMAX: CYCL CALL POS has positions of its own (X, Y and Z) that a shift cannot judge.
11 CYCL DEF 275 TROCHOIDAL SLOT ~: CYCL DEF 275 is not in the code database, so nobody reviewed its positions.
12 CYCL CALL: the cycle it runs (line 30) is not in the code database, so nobody reviewed its positions.
13 CYCL DEF 200 DRILLING ~: Q203 is written as +Q10, a variable or an expression, so it cannot be moved with the Z words.
14 L X+60 Y+60 R0 FMAX M99: part of the same cycle as line 33, which is left as written (a variable position).
IZ+5: written as an incremental distance, so a shift does not apply to it.
16 L Z-5 R0 FMAX M91: a machine position (M91): its positions are not in the program's coordinates, so a shift of the program does not apply to them.
